entities.name: SOR transparent container
entities.description: Information element that may be sent by the UE to acknowledge successful reception of the SOR transparent container IE in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message. It indicates the ME support of SOR-CMCI.

entities.name: User Equipment
entities.description: The UE may send the SOR transparent container IE to acknowledge successful reception.

entities.name: Successful reception of SOR transparent container
entities.description: Condition where the UE has successfully received the SOR transparent container IE in the REGISTRATION ACCEPT message.

entities.name: ME support of SOR-CMCI
entities.description: Property indicating that the Mobile Equipment supports SOR-CMCI functionality.

relations.description: UE may send the SOR transparent container IE when it has successfully received the SOR transparent container in REGISTRATION ACCEPT.
The SOR transparent container IE is sent by the UE only if it has successfully received the SOR transparent container in REGISTRATION ACCEPT.
The SOR transparent container IE indicates the ME support of SOR-CMCI.
